title: LuckRead D1-02 Combined W03 and W05 PostgreSQL 18 Schema Contract

excludedBindings.reason: W09 owns the governance and notification endpoint schema. W05 D1-02 delivery rows may retain opaque endpoint IDs only.

safetyInvariants: Apply the PostgreSQL-native W03 artifact before the W05 artifact to one disposable PostgreSQL 18 database.
Do not execute historical SQLite/D1 migration files against PostgreSQL.
Do not connect to Neon or execute remote DDL in this local rehearsal.
Do not mutate Cloudflare D1 or change Worker runtime bindings.
Do not import business rows; only the required W03 Snowflake allocator singleton row remains after bootstrap.
Do not create W09 notification_push_endpoints or include W05 D1-03 schema.
Do not add cross-domain foreign keys; content, user and endpoint identifiers remain opaque references.
